easy.def: A long bone in your lower arm.
examples: The ulna is an arm bone.
She hurt her ulna.
The ulna is next to the other arm bone.

more.def: One of the two long bones in the lower arm, on the side of the little finger.
examples: The ulna runs from the elbow to the wrist.
The ulna is the longer of the two bones in the forearm.
Her ulna healed after the cast came off.
The ultimate prize is a trophy.
This is the ultimate pizza.
The ultimate goal is to win.

more.def: Final, or the greatest or best of its kind.
examples: The ultimate goal is to win the cup.
That was the ultimate chocolate cake.
The ultimate winner is the one with the most points.
Ultimately, we won.
Ultimately, it is up to you.
He ultimately agreed.

more.def: After everything else, at the end.
examples: Ultimately, we won the game.
Ultimately, it is up to you to decide.
He ultimately agreed to help.
The ultra soft blanket was cozy.
An ultra bright light shone.
It is ultra cool.

more.def: Extremely, or going beyond what is usual.
examples: I love my ultra soft blanket.
The ultra bright light hurt my eyes.
She bought an ultra thin phone.
The sea was ultramarine.
She painted the sky ultramarine.
Ultramarine is a rich blue.

more.def: A deep, bright blue color, or the blue paint made from a stone.
examples: The artist used ultramarine for the deep blue of the sea.
Ultramarine is a strong blue, darker than the sky.
Her dress was a bright ultramarine.

easy.def: A picture of the inside of the body made with sound.
examples: An ultrasound makes a picture.
The doctor used an ultrasound.
It was an ultrasound.

more.def: A way to see inside the body using sound waves that are too high to hear.
examples: The doctor did an ultrasound to see the baby.
An ultrasound makes a picture with sound.
Ultrasound lets doctors see inside you.

easy.def: Light the eye cannot see, which can burn skin.
examples: Ultraviolet rays burn.
The sun gives off ultraviolet light.
Ultraviolet light is invisible.

more.def: Describing light waves just beyond violet that we cannot see.
examples: Sunscreen blocks ultraviolet rays from the sun.
Ultraviolet light cannot be seen by people.
Bees can see ultraviolet patterns on flowers.
